text:
Nate: Quick heads-up — Stonewell is offering a 4-week preview of their BladeX edge accelerator to run our inference suites. They require an internal NDA and a short feedback survey. Who can pick this up? cc @Priya @Iris :wave:

Priya: I can own the harness + initial runs. Need their disk image and any special kernel flags. Which model families do we target? 13B and 30B sound reasonable?

Iris: 13B for latency, 30B for long-context (20k). Capture cold-start vs warm-start, KV cache behaviour, and tail power. Primary metrics: p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory high-water, and power-mean/peak. Draft results by 2024-04-15 so partnerships can prepare embargoed slides.

Legal: NDA reminder — internal evaluation only. No external blog or benchmark release without partner sign-off. I'll add an embargo checklist to the runbook and require 72h review for any external material.

Stonewell-Rep: Hi all — we'll provide the BladeX image, SSH accounts, and a minimal telemetry schema. We can also provide per-step power CSVs and an API token for telemetry ingestion. We prefer embargo until mutual sign-off.

Priya: Perfect. I'll create a repo stub: https://git.redwood/integration/stonewell-bladex and add a reproducible run script. Example smoke command I'll use:
```
ssh blade@bladex-preview
sudo ./bench_runner --model redwood/30b-20k --seq 20480 --warm 300 --iters 300
```

Infra: Reserving 3 sandbox nodes for week of 2024-04-08. Image uploaded to s3://stonewell/bladex-20240401.img (19.8G). Will post IPs and temporary SSH creds to repo secrets.

Eval: I'll craft the eval sets and reproducibility checklist. We'll capture kernel, driver, firmware, and exact command line flags. Also include scripts to collect KV cache hit/miss metrics.

Priya: Telemetry plan — capture per-token latency spans, KV cache metrics, and ingest per-step power CSVs. If Stonewell offers POST ingest, we'll wire it up behind a test token. Example envs:
```
export STONEWELL_TELEM=https://telemetry.stonewell/api/ingest
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood-st-bl-aaa
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d @payload.json $STONEWELL_TELEM
```

Stonewell-Rep: We'll send sample payloads and API tokens early next week. Power CSVs will be ISO8601 timestamped. We can also do a paired smoke test streaming logs from our lab.

Nate: Good. Sync scheduled Tue 09:30 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry contract/schema, bench matrix, legal embargo flow, sign-off timeline. Please add pre-reads to the repo before the sync. :calendar:

Iris: Slot works. I'll upload the run matrices and target KPIs. If Stonewell can provide recommended driver/firmware combos, drop them in the repo so we can pin versions.

Legal: I'll upload the NDA checklist and embargo steps to the repo. Reminder: all external figures must be sent to Stonewell for approval 72h prior to release.

Priya: I'll start wiring the harness and post early smoke logs. If Stonewell can provide per-step power CSVs and a small telemetry schema, that will make analysis much smoother.

Stonewell-Rep: Confirmed — tokens, CSVs, sample payloads, and a short onboarding doc incoming tomorrow. Looking forward to the runs. :rocket:
